clues: I appear where the living fear to stay. Who am I?
You may hear whispers of me in a haunted house.
Some say I am the spirit of someone who is no longer alive.
I'm tiny, quick, and I prefer not to be noticed.
You might find me hiding where food is stored.
Cheese is the classic food people associate with me.
I have walls, but I'm not a prison.
You return to me when the day is done.
I am a place where people live and make memories.
I have no colour of my own, yet I can reflect the sky.
You need me to stay alive.
You drink me when you're thirsty.
I can connect two people who are miles apart.
I fit in your pocket but can open a world of information.
You use me to call, message, and browse.
I have legs but never take a step.
Things are often placed on top of me.
You might gather around me for dinner.
I have legs but I never walk.
I wait quietly for someone to rest.
You sit on me when your feet need a break.
People chase me, save me, and sometimes argue over me.
I can disappear quickly when you go shopping.
You use me to pay for things.
I can be soft inside and golden outside.
I often arrive at the table before the main meal.
I'm made mainly from flour and can be sliced for eating.
I carry many people but never drive on a road.
I follow a path made of two parallel lines.
I travel on railway tracks.
I grow on trees and can hide a tiny world of seeds inside.
Some of my colours include red and green.
I'm a fruit often associated with keeping the doctor away.
I chase away darkness without making a sound.
You notice my absence when everything becomes hard to see.
I help you see when it is dark.
